headline: Tekken 3 - the best fighting game?
title: Tekken 3 Memories | Jin, Eddy, Hwoarang | Classic Games
video_script: Tekken 3 hit arcades in nineteen ninety seven and PlayStation in nineteen ninety eight. It introduced fighters like Jin Kazama, Eddy Gordo and Hwoarang. Besides the main mode, it had fun extras like Tekken Force and Tekken Ball. Many players still call it the best fighting game ever. Who was your main? Comment below!
description: Tekken 3 (1997 arcade, 1998 PlayStation) - the debut of Jin Kazama, Eddy Gordo and Hwoarang, plus Tekken Force and Tekken Ball.
